Corrected per-token decode: 16.376 ms at a 106-token context over 492 dispatches (87.6% GEMM, 143.0 GB/s aggregate, 163.2 GB/s inside the GEMMs) and 17.204 ms at 1066 tokens (88.0% GEMM, 136.1 GB/s, 154.7 GB/s). Context length therefore costs 1.05x per token, not the 1.58x the whole-process attribution implied, and the 2342 MB fp32 text weights stream at 136-143 GB/s aggregate. Each decode phase carries a context span: the small-page run covers context 106-305 (mRoPE positions 50-249, mean context 206) and the full-page run 1066-1265 (positions 74-273, mean 1166), so the ratio compares mean contexts of 206 and 1166. Transfers inside the decode range are 0.007 ms/token (0.04%), not 0.29 ms/token; the 60 ms whole-process transfer total is setup. The 492 dispatches per token, 187 of them single-row SGEMV, remain the largest structural cost on top of the streaming.
